name: France: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator or another party are left empty, not invented.
Language is French (CV and declaration of interest: French or English).

Signature as required at CTIS submission: Additional France application document signed by the CTIS applicant; N1 signed by the person responsible for the site; ARS decision and CNIL receipt are the official signed documents; no signature on the other documents.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json.
Searchable-text PDF or editable format accepted by CTIS; no image-only PDF.

FR-K1.check: Uses the harmonised EU Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure Template version 2.0 (new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026), or the version required on the intended submission date.

Prepared in French; the yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section completed, each 'no' section says not applicable.

Covers identification, approach, information, decision time, how understanding is checked, how questions are answered, which version is signed and who presents the information, for every population pathway in the plan.
French national additions present in v105, v108, v110, v114, v117 and v121 as listed in requirements.json national_fields.
Minors: verification of parental authority, information per age group, personal adherence, recording of refusal and re-consent at 18.
Limited capacity: capacity assessment, verification of legal status and authority (curatorship, representation, no formal measure), participant involvement, dissent monitoring, later consent.
Impartial witness: when the route applies, distinction between capacity and inability to write, witness selection, alternative means, signatories.
Emergency: the operational Article 35 pathway, including checks of prior objection and representative availability before enrolment; not only a protocol sentence on deferred consent.
Healthy volunteers: identification, screening, decision time, compensation, any exclusion period and the consent process.
Electronic or remote consent described with the same information, identity, signature, copy and record requirements.
Recruitment routes and first act of recruitment match the recruitment material (FR-K2) and the protocol; where no separate advertising is planned, this is stated clearly.

FR-K-ADDITIONAL.check: The current CNRIPH Additional France application document is used, in French.
Records any exclusion period, the sponsor-investigator financial arrangements and the sponsor's MR-001 compliance position.
Dated and signed by the CTIS applicant (sponsor or the organisation submitting on the sponsor's behalf) at submission.
Exclusion period matches the protocol and the healthy-volunteer information.
Financial figures consistent with FR-P1 and the participant documents; no duplicated inconsistent figures.
MR-001 position matches FR-R1 (receipt, or CNIL authorisation to be obtained after the CPP opinion) and the participant privacy notices.

FR-M-SITE-LIST.check: Complete France site and principal-investigator list, in French, in the current EU or CTIS list format or as CTIS structured data; no signature.
Every France site and investigator matches across CTIS, the protocol, insurance and suitability documents (FR-M1, FR-M2, FR-N1, FR-O1).
Kept current through the relevant CTIS procedure after a change.

FR-M1.check: One CV for every investigator listed for France, on the EU CV template, in French or English; only trial title and EU trial number filled by the assistant.
Dated less than one year before submission and demonstrates relevant experience.
Shows recent GCP training (normally within three years) and the investigator's RPPS identifier, as completed by the investigator.

FR-M2.check: One declaration for every investigator, on the EU template, in French or English; interests answered by the investigator; no signature at submission.
Dated within one year before submission; updated if a relevant interest changed.

FR-N1.check: One statement per France site, in French, on the EU site-suitability template, confirming facilities, equipment, staff and organisation for this protocol.
Statements are specific to this protocol (IMP handling, procedures, population, safety management); site-specific facts are left for the site to confirm, not invented.
Dated and signed at submission by the person responsible for the site; a delegated department head only with visibility over the full trial activities at the site.
ARS authorisation planned under N where the site does not usually perform required acts (Article L1121-13 CSP).

FR-N-ARS.check: Official signed ARS decision for the specific site, in French, covering the non-routine acts; submitted before those acts are performed.

FR-O1.check: Issued and dated insurer document in French, from an insurer established in the European Union.
Covers the France trial period from the first participant included in France to the last participant's last visit; an annual certificate states the trial end date and is continuously renewed.
Identifies the trial and gives sponsor or legal-representative contact details; consistent with the insurance wording in every participant document.

FR-P1.check: Submitted on the EU compensation template in French, stating explicitly when no payment is offered.
Reimbursement, any constraint indemnity and any other payment stated; no financial advantage beyond reimbursement and the permitted indemnity.
Total constraint indemnity per person does not exceed EUR 6,000 over twelve consecutive months.
No constraint indemnity for minors or protected persons for whom French law prohibits it.
Amounts, conditions and recipients identical to every participant document; sponsor-investigator arrangements are in the Additional France application document, without inconsistent figures.

FR-R1.check: The applicable route is evidenced: CNIL MR-001 receipt (dated, issued and signed by CNIL; one per controller), or the CNIL authorisation once issued with the non-compliance declared in the Additional France application document.
Filed in the dedicated data-protection subsection, not the biological-sample subsection.
Controller on the receipt matches the sponsor or controller named in the participant documents.

FR-S1.check: Submitted on the EU biological-sample compliance template in French; no signature.
New and archive sample sections match the protocol and laboratory manual; analysis, storage, duration, access, coding and transfers match the participant documents.
Future use outside the protocol answered consistently with the separate secondary-use document and consent choices.
Section 5 (f03) contains the French national statement (Articles L1243-3 and L1243-4 CSP; new consent before a changed purpose; separate genetic consent).
